name: EXM_EXP_TYPE_PREF_AGNCY_MAP
description: This table stores mappings between expense types and preferred agencies.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense type this entry maps to.

columns.name: LOOKUP_TYPE
columns.description: Identifier of the user defined lookup defining the preferred agencies.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which this policy is applicable.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date after which this policy is no longer applicable.

columns.name: PREFERRED_ENFORCEMENT_CODE
columns.description: Type of preferred agency policy enforcement applied. Values are from lookup EXM_PREFERRED_ENFORCEMENT.

columns.name: DISP_WARNING_TO_USER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether policy warning is displayed to user.
